prompt: Create an ultra-realistic, premium lifestyle studio portrait of an adult standing in a relaxed, natural pose against a seamless warm gray studio background. The subject is smiling naturally while looking slightly upward and off-camera, conveying optimism, confidence, and approachability. The subject wears a layered casual-smart outfit consisting of an olive green bomber jacket over a light beige hoodie, dark slim-fit jeans, and clean light gray high-top sneakers. A minimalist black backpack is worn over one shoulder, with one hand comfortably holding the shoulder strap while the other arm rests naturally by the side. Capture the subject from head to toe with balanced body proportions and realistic anatomy. Maintain a relaxed posture with feet comfortably apart and natural weight distribution. Use soft professional studio lighting with subtle shadows, producing even skin tones and gentle contrast. Preserve realistic skin texture, natural facial details, and authentic clothing fabric textures. The bomber jacket should have a matte finish, while the hoodie appears soft and slightly textured. Style the portrait like a premium commercial fashion campaign for a modern lifestyle or travel brand. Keep the composition clean and uncluttered with generous negative space around the subject. Photographed using a Sony A7R V with an 85mm f/1.8 lens, ultra-high resolution, HDR, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus, realistic color grading, magazine-quality editorial photography, 8K, highly detailed, photorealistic, professional commercial lighting. Aspect Ratio: 4:5 vertical.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实、高端生活方式的摄影棚人像，主角为一名 成年人，以放松、自然的姿态站立在无缝的 暖灰色 摄影棚背景前。主角面带自然的微笑，视线略微向上并看向画外，传达出乐观、自信和亲和力。主角身着叠穿的商务休闲装，内搭浅米色连帽衫，外穿一件 橄榄绿飞行员夹克，搭配深色修身牛仔裤和干净的浅灰色高帮运动鞋。单肩背着一个极简主义黑色双肩包，一只手舒适地抓着肩带，另一只手臂自然下垂。全身拍摄，身体比例均衡，解剖结构真实。保持放松的姿势，双脚舒适分开，重心分布自然。使用柔和的专业摄影棚灯光，带有微妙的阴影，呈现均匀的肤色和柔和的对比度。保留真实的皮肤纹理、自然的面部细节和逼真的衣物面料质感。飞行员夹克应具有哑光质感，连帽衫则显得柔软且略带纹理。人像风格类似于现代生活方式或旅行品牌的高端商业时尚广告。构图简洁明快，主角周围留有充足的负空间。使用 Sony A7R V 相机搭配 85mm f/1.8 镜头拍摄，超高分辨率，HDR，浅景深，焦点锐利，色彩分级真实，杂志级编辑摄影，8K，高度细节，照片级真实感，专业商业灯光。纵横比：4:5 竖构图。
